model_feature_fields: properties.task_name(normalized lexical token with frequency cutoff)
notes: Raw IDs/PIDs are unstable identities and must not become predictive tokens.
hostname and timestamp are retained for correlation/splitting/order, not as direct host-model tokens.
FLOW is excluded from the host feature stream by default to keep host and network branches distinct; eCAR-Bro is used for cross-source correlation.
acuity_level is excluded initially because it may encode sensor/vendor severity heuristics; add only as a controlled ablation.
Command lines and payloads are parsed as inert text only. Never execute any command or script from the dataset.
